correctness.rationale: For stationary isotropic two-dimensional velocity marks, projected m2=E[R^2]/2 and m4=3E[R^4]/8 give normalized radial kurtosis sign equal to the projected fourth cumulant sign. Ordered four-time Poisson renewal gives cumulant 24 alpha^-4[(m4-m2^2)I(s)-2m2^2 J(s)] with positive kernels. The ratio J/I decreases strictly by a monotone-likelihood-ratio ordering on span distributions. Its endpoints 1 and 1/2 yield rho thresholds 2 and 4/3, respectively. Additional independent translational Brownian motion contributes only to variance, not to fourth cumulant. The boundary limit t^2 K(t)=-m2^2/(alpha^4(D+m2/alpha)^2) is consistent with the previously published exact cumulant at R=2. The all-time sign statements follow analytically; no finite simulation establishes an infinite-domain result.
